description: This file defines the 'AboutSettings' SwiftUI view for the OpenClaw application's 'About' or 'Settings' screen. It includes UI components such as application icon, version info, links, and update controls, and manages updater state.

classes.name: AboutSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays app info, links, and update controls in the About section.

classes.name: AboutLinkRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI View representing a clickable link row with icon and text.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Builds the main view layout containing app icon, info, links, and updater controls.

methods.name: versionString
methods.description: Returns the app version and build number as a string.

methods.name: buildTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the formatted build timestamp if available.

methods.name: gitCommit
methods.description: Retrieves the git commit hash from the app bundle.

methods.name: buildSuffix
methods.description: Generates a suffix string for the build, including the git commit and debug info.
